newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 23.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Sudanese president discusses peace initiative of United Arab Emirates' President Sheikh Zaid in Abu Dhabi.
- Pakistan hopes the Islamic summit would support its stand on India and Iran.
- Yemen's gross domestic product rose to $5.2 billion in 1996.
- Ninety German firms are seeking investment opportunities in Saudi Arabia.
- Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu plans to force two million Palestinians to go to Iraq.
- Foreign ministers of Gulf Arab states meet in Riyadh on Tuesday to review relations with Israel.
- Saudi American Bank to offer an investment fund, allowing investments by foreigners.
- Gulf and international experts to discuss on Tuesday in Abu Dhabi ways of developing Gulf infrastructure projects.
